Explains both the renderer's trailing trim (loop stops short + regex trim) and downstream whitespace stripping, and proposes full-width fixed geometry plus RESET+ESC[K erase that survives trimming, with SGR kept controlled.

Identifies tail2 hand-port mismatch of 23 changed cells (visible cluster is a subset), separates data drift from renderer artifacts, explains the different-frame excerpt test missed it, and requires per-frame digests against trusted source art.

Cites ci-hang evidence: never-unmounted probe hosts, self-rearming referenced setTimeout chain keeping the loop alive; unrefs the planner timer so animation continues while probes can exit; interactive TTY liveness explained.
Consolidated renderer checklist (absolute SGR, erase escapes, digest gate) plus a pre-rollout audit of timers/mounting hosts and an explicit exit/liveness regression.
